gaps.reason: [MATERIAL GAP] The evidence-synthesis record flow does not numerically separate AI-handled from human-handled records at every screening stage.
[MATERIAL GAP] No numeric AI performance evaluation against a reference standard is reported; same-family role separation is expressly not error-independent.
[GAP] The title/subtitle does not identify substantial AI assistance.
[GAP] The abstract does not name the AI tool and all assisted review/writing stages.
[GAP] No forward-looking reflection on AI utility for future evidence syntheses is provided.
[MATERIAL GAP] The introduction does not give a task-specific rationale for choosing each AI tool.

protocol_maturity.caveat_summary: PRISMA-trAIce is a foundational, immediately adoptable but preliminary proposal developed by systematic adaptation rather than Delphi consensus; its 17 items have not yet been empirically validated across diverse research contexts.
protocol_maturity.upstream_citation: Holst D, et al. Transparent Reporting of AI in Systematic Literature Reviews: Development of the PRISMA-trAIce Checklist. JMIR AI. 2025. doi:10.2196/80247
